Nature never fails to surprise us at Eklavya. 

We found lots of flowers fallen from this Akash Neem tree and got all our children out in nature. 

They discovered how this flower can be used to make bubbles around with a simple solution dip. The joy of blowing these bubbles and showing it to each other was unimaginable 🫶🏻🥹

#nature #indianparents #bubbles #naturebasedlearning #earlychildhoodeducation

Allow your child to be bored. Stop filling your child’s entire day with things to do. 

Only when they have nothing to do will they think for themselves. Their creative muscle will come to play as they learn to engage themselves. They will become more observant of things around them and develop an eye to identify problems and find solutions. 

Free time is the best gift of childhood. Let them enjoy it. 

#bored #freetime #indianparenting #playislearning #childdevelopment

Today, parents truly put in a lot of effort in unlearning and relearning various aspects to help their child the best. It is so wholesome to see parents come with a detailed research about schools and still be open to learning. 

🫶🏻🤗 We truly appreciate each and every one of you. 

#indianparents #indianparenting #childdevelopment #parentworkshop #school

We believe as a school it is collective responsibility to reduce children’s commute as much as possible. 

Children deserve to spend quality time at home after school so let’s give them that.

#bangaloretraffic #familytime #school

As a part of our field visit, we had Cane Basket Weavers come down to our school to teach children this unique skill. 

Our aim was to promote sustainability while teaching children to respect the craft these local vendors have offered for years. 

#sustainableliving #vocalforlocalindia #childdevelopment #earlychildhoodeducation #fieldvisit

Lets save competitive exams for later and allow our little children to enjoy their childhood for now. 

This is the age for them to fall in love with learning, be curious about exploring different concepts and enjoy every moment. 

#olympiads #competitiveexams #earlychildhoodeducation #childdevelopment #primaryschool

Modular wooden blocks give children unlimited scope of play. Every unit is carefully crafted with precision to ensure children never run out of a unit. 

This material holds immense value in our block room as it encourages collaborative play and stimulates their creativity. 

#woodenblocks #creativity #toysforkids #childdevelopment #playislearning

As a part of our Language week, we had various activities planned to enhance children’s language skills and see their growth so far in second language. 

One of the activities was Origami. One group of children had to give instructions to the other group of children in their respective second language without demonstrating. 

It was amazing to see how children were carefully picking words, translating the instruction in Kannada/Hindi and trying their best to explain it to their friends. 

#secondlanguage #kannada #hindi #activitiesforchildren #primaryschool

Self-correction in Montessori isn’t just with respect to materials, it is into everything. It’s to allow children to realise and form their own sense of right and wrong. 

Our role as adults is to observe and bring in interventions that help children realise right and wrong on their own. This one excerpt from my Montessori training under Frau Maria Roth really stuck with me and has become a way we imbibe the spirit of Montessori in Eklavya

#montessori #earlychildhoodeducation #childdevelopment #indianparenting #learningthroughexperience

A small piece of clay in a child’s hands is supports so much development in their brain while they explore it. 

#clay #earlychildhoodeducation #childdevelopment #playislearning #braindevelopment

Every time we meet an educationist, their passion and enthusiasm really inspired us. This is why even we strive towards giving back to the society by embodying this spirit of education and share everything we know freely. 

Frau Heinrikke Schauwecker was one such person, even at 90+ age she had so much enthusiasm to show us and explain the Froebel method of education. Language barriers Age nothing stopped her from creating a deep impact on our hearts.

{Froebel, best practices of education, inspiring educators, best education philosophies, Schools in Yelahanka, Schools in North Bangalore} 

#froebel #education #bestpractices #childdevelopment #passion

Toy Fair in Germany gave us a lot of exposure to the world of toys. Most manufacturers were also educators who deeply study the science of child development and develop toys accordingly to support the growth of the child. 

#toys #childdevelopment #travelstory #earlychildhoodeducation #school
